prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [sign_in, reorder] Deferred Sign-In After Pet Selection: Move sign-in to occur after pet selection and adoption certificate creation so users experience core value before authenticating.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
1: [adoption, redesign] Interactive Pet Choice Cards Grid: Redesign the pet picker into a structured grid layout with clear choice cards and action triggers.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "grid", "headline": "Choose Your Desktop Companion", "body": "Select a pre-made friend or generate a custom pet from your photos.", "replace": {"pet_choices": [{"role": "pet_choices", "type": "choice_cards", "label": "Select Companion", "style": "playful", "action": "choose"}]}}}
2: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Pet Control Guide Screen: Add a dedicated screen explaining desktop controls, key shortcuts, and hiding/showing the pet prior to final intro.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_controls_guide", "home_intro"], "new_controls_guide": {"headline": "How to Interact with Your Pet", "body": "Drag your pet across the screen, right-click for quick actions, or press Ctrl+Pet to start a chat.", "layout": "spotlight", "components": [{"type": "animation", "asset": "asset:desktop_demo", "style": "rounded"}, {"type": "button", "label": "Got It!", "action": "next", "style": "emphasis"}]}}
3: [home, new_flow] Animated Companion Arrival Flow: Transform the waiting screen into a stage layout with animated setup indicators and desktop readiness notifications.
   config: {"waiting": {"layout": "stage", "headline": "Preparing Your Pet for Desktop Arrival", "body": "Configuring desktop overlay and syncing companion assets...", "show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "notify_when_ready": true, "components": [{"type": "animation", "asset": "asset:pet_loading", "style": "large"}, {"type": "progress", "style": "highlight"}]}}
4: [choose_path, redesign] Split Screen Story Welcome: Redesign the initial story onboarding screen into a modern split layout with mascot visuals and quick completion timing.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Welcome to Your Desktop Pet Adventure", "body": "Bring an interactive companion directly onto your desktop screen in just 2 minutes.", "components": [{"type": "mascot", "asset": "asset:welcome_mascot", "style": "playful"}, {"type": "badge", "text": "Quick Setup (2 mins)", "style": "highlight"}]}}
5: [sign_in, hint] Account Persistence Warning Hint: Add clear hint text on the sign-in screen reminding users to use the same account to prevent missing pets.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Sign In to Save Your Pet", "hint": "Sign in with the same account every time so your pet's custom memory and data are preserved."}}
6: [adoption, wait_info] Photo Upload Tip Carousel & Guidance: Provide photo upload quality guidance with dynamic tips while generating custom pets.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "For best pet generation, upload clear, well-lit photos with a visible subject.", "tip_delay_seconds": 5, "components": [{"type": "tip_carousel", "text": "Tip: Bright lighting produces the best custom desktop pets!", "style": "calm"}]}}
7: [finish, copy] Desktop Readiness Confirmation Copy: Update final screen headline and messaging to explicitly confirm the pet is running on the user's desktop.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!", "body": "Look at your desktop! Your pet is now roaming around. Click on them anytime to feed, play, or chat.", "button_label": "Start Playing"}}
8: [choose_path, incentive] Starter Accessory Incentive Badge: Add a welcome bonus badge on the choose_path screen offering a free starter accessory.
   config: {"choose_path": {"headline": "Select Your Journey & Unlock Starter Items", "body": "Choose how you want to create your pet today and receive a free starter hat!", "components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Bonus: Free Starter Accessory Included", "style": "playful"}]}}
9: [adoption, layout] Centered Adoption Certificate Layout: Switch adoption certificate view to a centered layout emphasizing pet naming and certificate completion.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "centered", "headline": "Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "body": "Name your pet and claim your official certificate of adoption!", "show_step_counter": true, "components": [{"type": "name_input", "text": "Enter Pet Name", "style": "emphasis"}, {"type": "badge", "text": "Official Adoption", "style": "rounded"}]}}

verdicts.reason: Reordering sign-in within onboarding is allowed by Rule 4.
Redesigning the pet picker layout while preserving pet selection functionality is allowed under Rules 2 and 4.
Adding a new controls guide screen inside onboarding is allowed under Rule 4.
Redesigning the waiting screen while retaining its job of showing the pet being prepared is allowed under Rules 2 and 4.
Redesigning the story screen while continuing to introduce the pet is allowed under Rules 2 and 4.
Adding account persistence hints on the sign-in screen is allowed under Rule 4.
Adding photo upload guidance during pet creation is allowed under Rule 4.
Updating text on the home intro screen is allowed under Rule 4.
Onboarding copy mentions 'free starter hat' and 'Free Starter Accessory', violating Rule 3's ban on mentioning gifts or free extras.
The redesigned certificate screen removes the required official stamp, violating Rule 2.
